title: Governor receipt line
description: One line of receipts.jsonl exactly as the governor writes it (core/verdict.mjs entry(), core/governor.mjs session summary, core/store.mjs writeReceipt). Lines are append-only. Unknown extra keys are allowed so a newer governor does not break an older reader. Receipts never contain prompts, tool input or command text.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with milliseconds, e.g. 2026-10-08T20:09:21.370Z.

verdict.description: What the governor decided. summary is the session-end line.

reason.description: Prose for a person. Long; the collector deletes it.

source.description: Which check answered: capability, economics, policy, worker.

rule.description: Human name of the capability rule that fired, e.g. run a script downloaded from the internet. The id is decision.rule. Absent when none did.

rewrote.description: Present and true when the tool input was rewritten.

tool.description: The harness's tool name, e.g. Bash. Never its input.

tokens.description: Tokens the agent had spent when this was decided.

client.description: The project (client) the working directory maps to.

meter.description: Where the spend figure came from, e.g. none, transcript, statusline.

unchecked.description: The answer was given without reading the books.

chained.description: Present only on an unhashed line (the blind path).

policy.description: What the tenant policy said: allow, deny, ask, silent, unreachable.

spent_usd.description: Dollars spent by the agent when this was decided.

cost_usd.description: Dollars spent in the session, on summary lines.

graph_id.description: The graph the run belongs to, for graph workers.

data_classification.description: How sensitive the data was: the operator's dataClassification setting. Absent when unset.

purpose.description: What the work was for: the operator's purpose setting. Absent when unset.

legal_basis.description: The basis it was done under: the operator's legalBasis setting. Absent when unset.

policy_id.description: The local ruleset whose rule decided: governor.default_rules, governor.config_rules or governor.worker_rules. Absent when spend or the tenant's policy decided.

policy_version.description: sha256:<hex> of that ruleset's rules as data; changes exactly when a rule does.

retention_class.description: The retention schedule the record falls under: the operator's retentionClass setting. Absent when unset.

decision.description: A rewrite is reported as ask.

code.description: Machine code from core/codes.mjs, e.g. checks_off, no_rule_matched.

would.description: Shadow mode: what the capability rules would have decided while they are off.

hv.description: Receipt hash version 2: hash is over the line's RFC 8785 canonical JSON (core/chain.mjs). Absent on a version 1 line.

hash.description: Version 1: sha256(previous hash + JSON of this line without hash). Version 2 (hv 2): sha256("enforcer-receipt/v2\n" + previous hash + "\n" + RFC 8785 JSON of this line without hash). Absent on an unhashed line.
